nodes.label: Softree Brand Animation – Fiber Optic Tree Bloom (Frames 244–320)
nodes.description: Animation sequence (frames 244–320, chunk 12 of 48) from a Veo-generated brand video for Softree. The animation depicts a glowing fiber optic tree form with blue and pink/magenta light strands rising and blooming outward on a dark background. The trunk follows a sinuous S-shaped path (echoing the Softree 'S' logo), and the canopy fans into a wide arc of shimmering particle-like filaments. This segment represents the mid-to-late phase of the bloom animation. NOTE: Source frame files 244–320 were not present in the repository (frames only go up to 240); this node was inferred from adjacent frames 230 and 240 and the overall animation context.
